Usage: agentcage watcher findings [OPTIONS] NAME

  Show the traffic watcher's recorded findings.

Options:
  -s, --severity [info|low|medium|high|critical]
                                  Filter by severity (repeatable).
  --host TEXT                     Filter by domain/host (substring match,
                                  repeatable).
  -n, --max-entries INTEGER       Max findings to show (most recent; 0 = all).
                                  [default: 50]
  --json                          Output raw finding entries as JSON lines.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
